## Key Locations & Connectivity
- **Shivala More (Bodhgawa)**: Rapidly developing corridor situated 7-10 minutes from Saguna More via direct wide transit routes and the upcoming Danapur-Bihta elevated expressway. Close to AIIMS Patna.
- **Saguna More & Danapur**: Major commercial center with direct access to Danapur Railway Station, Bailey Road, Patna Airport, and the upcoming Patna Metro.
- **Bihta Corridor**: High-growth educational and industrial zone housing IIT Patna, NIT Patna, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, and the proposed Bihta Civil Airport.
- **Rajgir & Nalanda**: Scenic eco-living and tourism corridor with high long-term appreciation.
